Who compiles this: identity lock. Why it exists: why this program. You will not find a finished gravity law, a solved folder, or a biography. X = archive. GitHub = evidence. Wiki = compile. Industry interviews are a different ledger: public voice.

Core concept — It from bit, bind, and order / forced geometry.
Live board — Pillar 3 watch / september-2026-ladder.
Labs in English — UQCF-GEM reader.

Start from identities that cannot be erased — not spacetime, not a metric, not an inserted manifold — and ask what geometry-like structure, if any, is forced to appear so that one world is jointly recoverable. Pairs may look geometric; three-way recombination can produce an associator that will not reduce to pairs. That is forced geometry, not assumed geometry. Einstein is accepted as the physics of the slice. This wiki searches for signals of what gravity could be. It does not claim gravity has been found.

Every other program agrees information is fundamental — then smuggles in entropy, an area law, causal order, or a metric, and derives the rest. This ledger starts with nothing but identities that cannot be erased and rules for how they recombine. What survives is forced structure. Full page: /wiki/it-from-bit. 21 Sep field note: 2102247482579374550. Not Einstein. Not a STATUS gate.

Question: structure from retained information, not an inserted manifold. Method: freeze, ship, attack, badge. Review: AI red-team, not oracle. Public claim: a coherent ledger, not a physics or math discovery. Gravity and folding stay candidates.

Stack A (June causal ladder) owns Astra → Pin → L1–L4 → V1698/V824 → Package 17. Stack B (Sep Git ladder) owns parent → fiber → supplied [P] → [g]. Combining them drops you from Restricted to Not claimed. Cardinality 5=5 is not a functor. Two-stacks is the only page they appear together.

Spare capacity is not reachable reserve, and that is not a general no-go. Einstein not closed. scientific_breakthrough: false.

Chain: retained graph → quantum-site carrier STOPPED. state-independent lift → noncentral P NO-GO. state + graph-site → P_f LAWFUL, NONUNIQUE. [A] → [P] EXACT COMPRESSION. [P] → X* → [g] CERTIFIED CONDITIONAL. Pillar 3 OPEN. The only “what is current” URL is GitHub STATUS.md.

The method is a meter. It classifies a frozen question and may return INVALID or UNRESOLVED. Those readings are not a pass, and they are not a source law. Frontier on this wiki remains STATUS.md at v15.03. Research through v16.55 is not current science. v16.55 certifies a bounded renewable-guard repair on the integration branch and does not prove a universal root repair. The overlapping-guard branch, tip 1e7cd09 on 10 Oct 2026, is also not on main. Scoped C3 closeouts say static spare capacity need not be reachable, even from a source that has safe local edits. That is not a general impossibility. Count reconstructions do not derive access. Broad C3 and native record origin stay open. None of this derives P, and a uniform barrier is not a no-go. The finite mathematics is Restricted. It does not close gravity.

How to read a badge

Supported — reproduced in a named harness with a stated residual or statistic. Four of these, currently.
Restricted — true inside an explicit domain: this family, this graph size, this sector.
Open — a derivation target. Not a result.
Not claimed — the author has put it out of scope, or a 2025 voice the 2026 ledger does not adopt.
Corrected — an earlier blanket claim was withdrawn. The walk-back sits next to the original.
